o.norm: Test Longley dataset against R. Data Source: J. Longley (1967) "An Appraisal of Least Squares Programs for the Electronic Computer from the Point of View of the User" Journal of the American Statistical Association, vol. 62. September, pp. 819-841. Data are from NIST: http://www.itl.nist.gov/div898/strd/lls/data/LINKS/DATA/Longley.dat

i.norm: Verifies Covariance computation against the Longley dataset using R as a reference implementation. Data source: J. Longley (1967) "An Appraisal of Least Squares Programs for the Electronic Computer from the Point of View of the User", JASA vol. 62, pp. 819-841. Raw data from NIST: http://www.itl.nist.gov/div898/strd/lls/data/LINKS/DATA/Longley.dat
Longley dataset: 16 annual US economic observations (1947-1962). Columns: Employment, GNP_Deflator, GNP, Unemployed, ArmedForces, Population, Year
Expected 7x7 covariance matrix for LONGLEY_DATA, computed by R. Rows/columns correspond to the same variable order as in LONGLEY_DATA.
